notes.title: AtmaSphere 1.7
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31201012/31e4bdbe115c6125d8e6322bc99c360c10d7160f.png

Hey!

Join the official MazenGames group on Steam HERE!

AtmaSphere 1.7 Update

- improved loading time of levels & main menu 
- completely reworked the main menu & the pause menu
- added sparks when player collides with some objects!
- fixed some issues with sounds when colliding
- falling platforms now regularly reset back after a short period
- your best time on a level is no more logged and shown in-game
- number of under the hood improvements
- optimized occlusion culling for all levels

If you like AtmaSphere, please leave a review on Steam! Thank you! <3
Restart Steam for it to download new updates!

notes.content:

Hey!

If you like AtmaSphere, please leave a review on Steam! Thank you! <3

Update #9 is changing the last 3 levels a bit and music bug fix.

Levels 28, 29, 30: Widened some rails, removed some spikes, added some platforms
 Music bug fix: no more high volume 'jumpscares' - music should now play at the volume you set it to in main menu
Splash screen now has the new MG logo

notes.title: Update #8
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31201012/1d2df77d4cf236e53a4c5738d05c926dd81ffc23.jpg

Hey, we've heard you!

Join the official MazenGames group on Steam HERE!

Update #8 is about balancing the last 10 levels.

LEVEL22: Made some rails wider, one more added checkpoint close to the end of the level
LEVEL23: Some rails have been made wider, added more rails on one part of the level
LEVEL24: Rails where you gain height have been widened, spawn rate of balls dropping from the sky has been changed to 2.1 seconds from 1.8 seconds
LEVEL26: Increased the spike reactivation time, so it now takes a longer time for some of the spikes to reactivate
LEVEL27: Widened some rails
LEVEL29: Removed some of the spikes, increased the width of some rails
Version is now changed to 1.5.3


If you like AtmaSphere, please leave a review on Steam! Thank you! <3
Restart Steam for it to download new updates!

notes.title: Update #4
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

How do you like AtmaSphere?

Update #4 brings achievements fix and some minor optimizations.


Fixed an issue where some achievements would not trigger when they were supposed to. For example when you picked up 1700 yellow coins but you did not get an achievement for 1600 yellow coins. When you start AtmaSphere, those locked achievements which you were supposed to unlock should pop now.
 Removed achievements: Fall 90, Fall 100, Fall 110, Fall 120, Fall 130, Fall 140, Fall 150. There is now 8 achievements for falling down in total. We're sorry!


http://steamcommunity.com/groups/mazengames
Join our Steam Group! 

If you encounter any problems, please report them in the discussions section. Restart Steam for it to download new updates! If you like AtmaSphere, please leave a review on Steam! Thank you! <3

notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Are you enjoying AtmaSphere?

Update #3 brings fixes and new features.


    Added a volume slider for background music
    Added a volume slider for background rain
    Fixed the dropdrown in leaderboards tab.
    Changed the looks of buttons in leaderboards tab
    Fixed issue when playing on a controller, sometimes level timer did not work properly
    Optimized some levels where there was too many lights
    Added version label in the right bottom corner in main menu
    Disabled "floating" motion on yellow coins to prevent them from going into platforms
    Made almost all levels a little bit easier


Enjoy AtmaSphere! If you encounter any problems, please report them in the discussions section. Restart Steam for it to download new updates! Thank you! <3
